title: 49 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Inner Peace)
description:
Learn 49 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Inner Peace · Amani ya Ndani
1:21  Happiness · Furaha
2:40  Perseverance · Uvumilivu
3:59  Agreeing & Disagreeing · Kukubali na Kukataa
5:17  Kindness · Wema
6:40  Meeting People & Greetings · Kukutana na Watu na Salamu
7:50  Emergency & Health · Dharura na Afya
9:11  Creativity · Ubunifu

PHRASE LIST

INNER PEACE · Amani ya Ndani
• I soften my shoulders, right now. - Nayasinya mabega yangu, sasa hivi.  [NAyasinya mabeGA yangu, SAza hiVi.]
• I let silence talk to me. - Ninamruhusu ukimya kunizungumza.  [NINAmruhusu U-KIMya ku-nZUNGUMZa.]
• I choose gentleness over pressure. - Naanzisha upole kuliko shinikizo.  [NAaNziSha u-pole kuLiKo SHINiKiZo.]
• My inner weather is calm today. - Hali ya ndani yangu ni tulivu leo.  [HAli ya DNani yangu ni tuLIVu LEO.]
• I stop arguing with my mind. - Niacha kubishana na mawazo yangu.  [NIaCHA kuBIshanA na maWAZo yangu.]
• I release the need to control. - Nawacha hitaji la kudhibiti.  [NAwaCHA HItajI la kuDHIbiti.]

HAPPINESS · Furaha
• I choose gratitude, even today. - Ninaamua shukrani, hata leo.  [Ninaamua SHUKRANI, hata LEO.]
• Right now, my heart feels safe. - Kwa sasa, moyo wangu unahisi salama.  [Kwa sasa, MOYO wangu unahisi SA-LA-MA.]
• Small wins make me smile. - Ushindi mdogo hunifanya tabasamu.  [Ushindi MDoGO hunifanya taBASaMU.]
• I’m letting go of old stress. - Ninaacha msongo wa mawazo wa zamani.  [NinaAcha MSOnGO wa MA-AZO wa ZaMA-ni.]
• This good mood is contagious. - Hali hii njema inanifanya nitulie na kuambukiza furaha.  [HA-li hii NJE-ma inaNifanya niTULIE na kuAMBU-ki-za FU-ra-ha.]
• I enjoy the way life unfolds. - Nafurahia jinsi maisha yanavyojikunja.  [Na-FU-ra-i-a jinsi MA-AI-sha ya-navyo-jikUN-jA.]

PERSEVERANCE · Uvumilivu
• I can slow down and still win. - Ninaweza kupunguza mwendo na bado kushinda.  [Naweza KUPUNGUZA mwendo na bado KUSHINDA.]
• I keep going, even when it hurts. - Ninaendelea, hata inapouma.  [Ninaendelea, HATA inapouma.]
• Today I choose persistence over perfection. - Leo ninachagua uvumilivu kuliko ukamilifu.  [Leo ninachagua uvumilivu KUPITA ukamilifu.]
• I show up again, that counts. - Ninarudia kuonekana, hilo linahesabika.  [Ninarudia KUONEkana, HILO linahesabika.]
• One hard task, then I rest. - Kazi moja ngumu, kisha napumzika.  [Kazi moja NGUMU, kisha NAPUMZIKA.]
• I will finish what I started. - Nitamaliza nilichoanza.  [NitaMALIZA nilichoANZA.]

AGREEING & DISAGREEING · Kukubali na Kukataa
• Yes, that’s the right call for me. - Ndiyo, huo ndio uamuzi sahihi kwangu.  [NdiYO, huo ndio uAamuzi SAHIHI kwangu.]
• I agree, and I feel confident. - Ninakubaliana, na nina uhakika.  [NinaKUBALIana, na nina uHAKIKA.]
• That’s true, I’ve thought the same. - Ni kweli, nimefikiria hivyo hivyo.  [Ni KWELI, ni meFIKIRIA hivyo hivyo.]
• Exactly, let’s move forward together. - Ndiyo kabisa, tuendelee mbele pamoja.  [NdiYO kaBISA, TUENDElee MBELE pamoja.]
• I’m on board with that plan. - Niko tayari kuunga mkono mpango huo.  [Niko taAYari kuUNGА mkono MPANGO huo.]
• I don’t agree, but I respect it. - Sikubaliani, lakini naiheshimu.  [SI kubaliani, lakini naIHESHIMU.]

KINDNESS · Wema
• Say sorry, then make it right. - Omba msamaha, kisha fanya jambo sahihi.  [OMba MAsaHa, KIsha FANya JAMbo SAHIHI.]
• Check in, even when busy. - Pigia simu au tuma ujumbe kuuliza hali, hata ukiwa na shughuli nyingi.  [PIgiA siMU au TUma UJUmbe KUliiZA HAlI, HAta ukiWA NA SHAughuli NYingi.]
• Let someone go first, kindly. - Mpatie nafasi aende mbele, kwa wema.  [MPAatie NAFASI aENde mbeLe, kwa WEmo.]
• Thank them for small things. - Mshukuru kwa vitu vidogo, vina thamani.  [MShuKUru kwa VItu viDogo, VIna THAmaNi.]
• Share without keeping score. - Gawanya, bila kuhesabu faida.  [GAwANya, bila kuHEsabU FAIda.]
• Keep your tone soft in conflict. - Ongea kwa sauti tulivu hata mnapogombana.  [ONgeA kwa SAuti TUliVu HAta mnaPOgombANA.]

MEETING PEOPLE & GREETINGS · Kukutana na Watu na Salamu
• Hi! How’s your day going? - Habari, siku yako inaendaje?  [Ha-bari, si-ku ya-ko i-naeN-de-je?]
• Where are you headed today? - Unaelekea wapi leo?  [U-na-e-lE-kea wa-pi le-o?]
• What’s your name, please? - Jina lako ni nani, tafadhali?  [Ji-na la-ko ni na-ni, ta-fa-dha-li?]
• I’m glad we ran into each other. - Nimefurahi sana tukakutana hapa.  [Ni-me-fu-ra-hi sa-na tu-ka-ku-ta-na ha-pa.]
